A1.justification: Both PDFs are complete, readable versions of the same work. Their text, equations, five figures, references, and Appendices A–B support reliable comparison through text extraction and rendered-page inspection.

before.justification: v2 reports original Gaussian-mixture simulation results in Section 3.2 and SmolLM2 distillation experiments, precision/recall measurements, and embedding visualizations in Sections 4.3–4.4.

after.justification: v3 retains the original Gaussian-mixture and SmolLM2 experimental results, including numerical simulation outcomes and the empirical comparisons in Figures 4–5.

M1.justification: Both retain the same entropy-controlled Gaussian-mixture distillation, forward-KL objective, and SmolLM2 1.7B-to-360M-to-135M pipeline. No algorithmic component, training objective, or inference procedure changes.

E1.justification: Both evaluate the same synthetic Gaussian-mixture task and language modeling on SmolLM2-generated text. The added main-text mentions of reasoning tasks remain discussion; no downstream evaluation is introduced.

E2.justification: The Gaussian simulation and LLM experiment retain their directly trained student baselines alongside distilled students. No evaluated comparison method is added, removed, or replaced.

E3.justification: The model sizes, four teacher-sampling temperatures, 10M-sequence training datasets, 100,000-sequence evaluation sets, and precision/recall definitions are unchanged. Appendix A retains the same training, checkpoint-selection, and UMAP settings.

E4.justification: The temperature-dependent comparisons and embedding-space analysis in Sections 4.3–4.4 retain the same evidence. No ablation, robustness test, or empirical case study is added or removed; Appendix B remains conceptual discussion.

E5.justification: Section 4.2 specifies five random seeds in both versions. Figure 4 retains the same boxplots and caption describing interquartile ranges across seeds and orange lines indicating arithmetic means.

E6.justification: Section 3.2 retains direct-student precision/recall of -20.26/-2.64 and distilled-student values of -0.70/-42.45. All plotted results are unchanged, including Figure 4's score distributions and Figure 5's embedding patterns.

T1.justification: The Gaussian-mixture assumptions, teacher reweighting, Jensen-inequality derivation, difficulty definition, and precision/recall equations remain unchanged. Edits to punctuation following equations do not alter their mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same precision–recall explanation and simulation/LLM validation claims. The revised conclusion's explicit mention of reasoning reiterates applicability already discussed in v2 Appendix B.1.

C2.justification: The distributional-concentration interpretation, coarse-embedding caveat, and limitation to pretraining experiments remain unchanged. Reasoning-task references added to Sections 4.3 and 5 repeat the interpretation already developed in Appendix B.1.

D1.justification: The code-access link and Appendix A's hardware, optimization, initialization, tokenization, and visualization details are unchanged. No implementation detail or resource-access information is added or removed.

R1.justification: Both contain the same 28 references and substantive related-work discussion. Positioning around entropy-controlled forward KL and the ground-truth–teacher–student framework is retained.

P1.justification: v3 makes scattered copyedits to punctuation, Gaussian-mixture terminology, figure-panel references, and concluding prose. Brief reasoning-task mentions bring existing appendix discussion into the main text; section order and overall exposition remain stable.

P2.justification: Figures 1 and 5 are enlarged, and Figure 3 is slightly enlarged. Figure positions and surrounding text reflow, moving the starts of Sections 4 and 5 to subsequent pages. Graphic content, axes, legends, captions, and figure inventory remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 modestly improves readability through larger Figures 1 and 5, more consistent references and terminology, and clearer concluding wording. The theory, experimental evidence, uncertainty reporting, and reproducibility appendices remain substantively unchanged, so the overall gain is limited to presentation.
